'''Mary D. Beisiegel''' is a Professor in the Department of Mathematics at [[Oregon State University]].<ref>[https://math.oregonstate.edu/directory/mary-d-beisiegel Mary D. Beisiegel]. Department of Mathematics. Oregon State University. Accessed 9 November 2023.</ref> She is a Whiteley Faculty scholar for Teaching Excellence. Her research is in mathematics education.

==Education and career==

Beisiegel received her PhD in [[Mathematics]] from the [[University of Alberta]] in 2009. Her dissertation, ''Being (Almost) a Mathematician: Teacher Identity Formation in Post-Secondary Mathematics'', was supervised by Elaine Simmt, David Pimm, and Terrance Ronald Carson.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=139827}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==

Beisiegel received the [[Mathematical Association of America]]'s [[Henry L. Alder Award|Henry L. Adler Award]] in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2017-07-26|title=U of A alumna adds math education award to her achievements|url=https://illuminate.ualberta.ca/content/u-alumna-adds-math-education-award-her-achievements|access-date=2021-04-09|website=Illuminate – the Faculty of Education Magazine}}</ref>
